description: Quote a single-pool swap on Chainzy V3 (a third-party testnet venue, not Kinetiq) on Kinetiq Elysium Testnet (99801) via QuoterV2 eth_call. Quote-only and non-executable: never signs, broadcasts or returns a transaction or router calldata; raw token units, testnet values are unpriced. Symbols resolve only WHYPE and USDC to the official addresses; look-alikes are refused. Mainnet unsupported until published.

allowTokens.description: Optional exact addresses allowed besides official WHYPE/USDC; look-alikes are refused even if listed.

amount.description: Positive amount in raw token units, decimal string (input for exactIn, output for exactOut).

fee.description: Optional fee tier; default tries every enabled tier.

network.description: mainnet is refused: no Kinetiq Elysium mainnet is published.

tokenIn.description: Exact 99801 token address, or the symbol WHYPE or USDC (official addresses only).

tokenOut.description: Exact 99801 token address, or the symbol WHYPE or USDC (official addresses only).

name: kinetiq_elysium_chainzy_quote
